featured_reviews.name: Alistair Bangera
featured_reviews.review_text:
I got a false ceiling made from them. Their pricing was good. Their overal system is efficient for tracking & making payments. But the contractor assigned was unskilled and very weak in communication. The workers made multiple errors and wasted my time and energy to explain how the basic design of the false ceiling should be which resulted in rework. I had a very basic non complicated design. In  addition, the day I did my last payment, the workers & completely stopped taking my phone for some issues i had regarding the work. The freshhomez whatsapp no that was so eager to get my booking started ignoring my messages.  After sales support was zero.

Better to go with a person who has a good referral from someone you know, rather than randoms on their system who im afraid are not rated or evaluated correctly. They might have good workers, but I got a dud.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got my office modular ceiling done by Rahemat Interiors, and I couldn’t be happier with the entire experience.
Rahemat is an absolute professional — knowledgeable, punctual, and genuinely helpful from start to finish. He took the time to clearly explain all the available options, along with the pros and cons of each, and gave transparent, detailed estimates so I could make an informed decision. In the end, he offered a really good deal that made the project even more worthwhile.
The work was completed exactly as promised, on time and with excellent quality. I’m truly impressed with the final result — it looks clean, modern, and perfectly executed. I would strongly recommend Rahemat Interiors to anyone looking for modular ceiling or false ceiling work.
As an added bonus, he even helped me find a reliable carpenter for some small odd jobs I needed done. That extra support meant a lot.
Highly recommended! 👍
